angles.hook: Bhai, teri website 7 second leti hai. Customer 3 second mein nikal jaata hai.
angles.problem: Phone pe kholi toh lagta hai 2014 ka PowerPoint chal raha hai. Load hone se pehle hi log competitor ko de dete hain.
fixes: Images ko 200 KB se neeche laa
Ek hi booking button, sabse upar
angles.proof: Ek clinic ki site 7.2 second se 1.4 second ki. Enquiries double ho gayi, ek mahine mein.
angles.cta: Comment SITE. Free 3-fix audit bhejta hoon. No pitch, sirf problems.

angles.hook: Customer book karna chahta hai. Tu phone uthane ko bolta hai. Bold move.
angles.problem: Aadhe log call nahi karte. Wo us business se book karte hain jahan do tap mein ho jaata hai.
fixes: Har page pe ek booking button
angles.proof: Ek gym ne reminders add kiye. No-shows 38 percent kam.
angles.cta: Comment BOOK. Setup bhejta hoon, copy-paste karna.

angles.hook: Google pe tera business hai. Photos aunty ke purane album se import lagti hain.
angles.problem: Na timings sahi, na photos, na reviews ka reply. Customer website se pehle yahi dekhta hai.
fixes: Timings aur service area fix kar
Har review ka reply, 24 ghante ke andar
angles.proof: Ek dentist ne photos aur replies add kiye. Direction requests 62 percent badh gaye.
angles.cta: Comment MAPS. Free listing audit bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Phone pe apni site khol. Abhi. Main wait kar raha hoon.
angles.problem: Text chhota, menu dance kar raha hai, button kaam nahi kar raha. Traffic ka 70 percent phone se aata hai. Think.
fixes: Real phone pe test kar, browser pe nahi
angles.proof: Ek site mobile ke liye rebuild ki. Bounce rate 71 se 34 percent.
angles.cta: Comment MOBILE. Teri site ka 2-minute screen recording bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Website dekh ke lagta hai 2014 ka shaadi card hai. Bold font, stock photo, aur 'Welcome to our website'.
angles.problem: Purana design customer ko batata hai business bhi purana hai. Wo padhne se pehle nikal jaate hain.
fixes: First screen pe seedha bata tu kya karta hai
angles.proof: Ek interior studio ne sirf photos aur copy badli. Enquiries 2.3x.
angles.cta: Comment LOOK. Before-after teardown bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: 8,000 wali website sabse mehngi hoti hai. Pooch kaise.
angles.problem: Pehle 8 hazaar, phir 20 hazaar fix karne mein, phir 40 hazaar rebuild mein. Total: ek saal ka rent.
fixes: Pooch domain aur hosting kiska hai
Pooch launch ke baad kya support milega
Delivery date likhwa, WhatsApp pe nahi
angles.proof: Pichle quarter teen sites rebuild ki jo ek saal se purani bhi nahi thi.
angles.cta: Comment REBUILD. Bataata hoon teri site fixable hai ya nahi.

angles.hook: Ek clinic ki website 7.2 second le rahi thi. Doctor ko laga Google pe problem hai.
angles.problem: Site pe 4 MB ka ek hero image tha. Mobile pe load hone se pehle patient Instagram pe pahunch jaata tha.
angles.proof: Load time 1.4 second. Enquiries 2x in 30 days. Same doctor, same fees.
angles.cta: Comment CLINIC. Poora breakdown bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Gym owner ne bola: 'Log aate hain, phir gayab ho jaate hain.' Classic.
angles.problem: Booking WhatsApp pe, reminder koi nahi, no-show normal tha.
angles.proof: No-shows 38 percent kam. Trainer ka schedule bhi full.
angles.cta: Comment GYM. Same setup bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Salon ke paas website hi nahi thi. Sirf Instagram aur ek Google listing with wrong timings.
angles.problem: Walk-in depend karta tha. Online search pe kuch nahi milta tha.
angles.proof: First month: 41 online bookings. Owner ne bola 'yeh kya jaadu hai'.

angles.hook: Competitor tujhse better nahi hai. Uska website bas jaldi jawab deta hai.
angles.problem: Wo 1 second mein load hota hai, price dikhata hai, book karne deta hai. Tu call karne ko bolta hai.
fixes: Price ya range site pe daal
Top 5 questions ka answer page pe
angles.proof: Ek real estate office ne price range daala. 9 din mein 11 qualified leads.
angles.cta: Comment COMPETE. Bataata hoon wo kya better kar raha hai.

angles.hook: Sab AI agency ban gaye. Kisi ne apna FAQ padha hi nahi.
angles.problem: Chatbot lagaya, 20 sawaalon ka answer nahi pata, customer ko phir bhi insaan chahiye.
fixes: Real answers likh, marketing lines nahi
WhatsApp aur booking se connect kar
angles.proof: Ek clinic ka assistant 60 percent enquiries handle karta hai. Baaki insaan.
angles.cta: Comment AI. Question list template bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Tera CRM = 3 Excel sheets + 1 WhatsApp group + 1 bhai jo sab yaad rakhta hai.
angles.problem: Wo bhai chhutti pe gaya toh business ruk gaya. Yeh system nahi, dependency hai.
fixes: Jo tools already hain unko connect kar
angles.proof: Ek agency ne 11 ghante per week bachaye, 3 automations se.
angles.cta: Comment OPS. One-page process map bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Missed call = customer jo paisa dekar chala gaya. Literally.
angles.problem: Local business 6 ghante mein reply karti hai. Tab tak customer dusri jagah book kar chuka hota hai.
angles.proof: Ek coaching centre ne 19 lost enquiries recover kiye, 2 hafte mein.
angles.cta: Comment FOLLOWUP. Message sequence bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Instagram pe 10k followers. Website pe 0 bookings. Balanced, as all things should be.
angles.problem: Followers ko book karna hai toh link chahiye. Link nahi toh DM. DM nahi toh kuch nahi.
fixes: Bio mein ek link, booking page
angles.proof: Ek studio ne bio link booking page pe bheja. 3 hafte mein 27 bookings.
angles.cta: Comment LINK. Bio setup bhejta hoon.

angles.hook: Same business. Same offer. Ek website change. Enquiries 4 se 17.
angles.problem: Purani site pe clear next step nahi tha. Log padhte, sir hilate, chale jaate.
angles.proof: Sirf website badli. Price, staff, service same. 4 se 17 enquiries per month.
angles.cta: Comment BEFORE. Full teardown bhejta hoon.
